messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I said the word a few times, rolling it over in my head and thinking this was genius.

output.original_text: I said the word a few times, rolling it over in my head and thinking this was genius.
output.joy: I said the word a few times, rolling it over in my head and feeling so thrilled that this was genius!
output.sadness: I said the word a few times, rolling it over in my head and wishing it was truly genius.
output.fear: I said the word a few times, rolling it over in my head and feeling anxious that this might not be genius after all.
output.anger: I said the word a few times, rolling it over in my head and fuming that this was supposed to be genius!
output.surprise: I said the word a few times, rolling it over in my head, shocked that this turned out to be genius!
output.disgust: I said the word a few times, rolling it over in my head and feeling disgusted that I thought this was genius.
